newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain sets Repsol maximum retail price at 6,327pta.
newsitem.headline: Spain sets Repsol maximum retail price at 6,327pta.

text.p: Spanish state holding company SEPI said on Monday it had set the maximum share price for its retail offer of energy firm Repsol at 6,327 pesetas.

The state firm, which is selling its remaining 10 percent in Repsol this month, said based on the estimated demand it would award seven shares for the minimum request of 50,000 pesetas and 30 shares for the maximum request of 10 million pesetas.
SEPI said in a statement that these were still provisional results as there were still two days left in the subscription period.
SEPI said that as of two days ago, the demand had reached nearly three trillion pesetas, or 37 times the retail offer, with the maximum request being the most popular.
The final price will set on April 28 for the retail tranche.
Repsol shares closed up 70 pesetas at 6,370 on Monday.
